question: What is the ultimate material cause of a pot whose immediate material is clay?
premises: Clay is the direct material cause of a pot.
A direct material cause can itself have a prior cause.
Māyā is that prior material cause.
inference: Therefore Māyā alone is the ultimate material cause of the pot.
plain_english: Even when clay is the direct material of a pot, Māyā alone is its material cause indirectly.
